newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares inch ahead on oil price rise report.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares inch ahead on oil price rise report.

text.p: NEW DELHI, June 18 (New Delhi) - Delhi stocks posted modest gains in early afternoon trade on Wednesday as foreign investors and speculators, spurred by the possibility of a smaller than expected increase in oil prices, snapped up major blue chips.
At 12.45 p.m. (0715 GMT), the Delhi Stock Exchange's benchmark index was up 0.74 point at 865.97.
